reviews.title: Knows my iPad somehow
reviews.text:
I was scrolling through the App Store a 30 minutes ago, and saw this I thought it was a fonts thing and I said “oh! I’ve had it? But I don’t remember it,” 
Later I remembered recently, the AppStore has been thinking “oh, she has downloaded this!” And they put it on my iPad, I have not, just saying it will take your everything saved, because the AppStore stopped that 2 weeks ago and it didn’t say this 3 weeks ago, please make this better Im scared now. 😱
